label: Transactions
summary: Transaction lifecycle functions and failure handling around database writes.
must_follow: Use :TRY/:CATCH around multi-step transactional database work.
Call GetLastSSLError() inside :CATCH when error details are needed.
Make rollback behavior explicit for write operations that can partially fail.
avoid: Do not leave transaction boundaries implicit in specs or refactors.
Do not put control-flow exits inside :FINALLY.

elements.name: BeginLimsTransaction
elements.summary: Starts a LIMS database transaction on the default connection or on a named connection.

elements.name: EndLimsTransaction
elements.summary: Ends a LIMS transaction on the default connection or on a named connection.

elements.name: GetTransactionsCount
elements.summary: Returns the number of open database transactions for a specified or default connection.

elements.name: IsInTransaction
elements.summary: Returns .T. if the specified database connection currently has an open transaction.

elements.name: SQLExecute
elements.summary: Executes SQL and returns either query results or a success flag.

elements.name: RunSQL
elements.summary: Executes a SQL statement and returns whether execution completed without an uncaught SQL error.

elements.name: GetLastSSLError
elements.summary: Retrieves the most recent SSL error encountered during the current process.
